## Flame v2.6.1

This release improves the settings interface and adds configurable typography for the large clock and the quote library.

### Features and fixes
- **Cleaner backup settings:** improved contrast, spacing and styled YAML export.
- **Unified interface save:** quote library and interface settings share one Save changes button and are updated in a single SQLite transaction.
- **Quote styles:** normal, italic, dimmed or italic dimmed.
- **Dedicated Clock section:** choose from common system fonts, JetBrainsMono and 3270 Nerd Fonts, four responsive sizes and four styles (normal, bold, italic, bold italic).
- **Optional LCD faces:** personal-install helper for five DaFont families. These are excluded from the Docker image due to redistribution and commercial-use license restrictions.
- **Regression coverage:** expanded HTTP and browser tests for quote and clock preferences, persistence and bundled font delivery.

### Upgrade notes
All new clock and quote preferences have backward-compatible defaults; persistent settings remain in SQLite. Back up your `/app/data` directory before upgrading.

**Font licensing:** the Docker build bundles permitted Nerd Fonts; the five optional LCD font families require separate installation and review of the relevant licenses. See [clock font documentation](https://github.com/erathaowl/flame/blob/v2.6.1/docs/clock-fonts.md).

### Docker
Available for `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64`:

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/erathaowl/flame:v2.6.1
```

The release workflow also publishes `latest`.
